Spec 108-l (L14, contracts/refusals.md): the four refusals every surface shares, byte-for-byte after substituting

(a profile name) and (a client id). REST (TestProfilesV3RefusalParity in internal/httpapi), the MCP profiles tool (TestProfilesV3RefusalParity_MCP in internal/server) and the CLI (TestProfilesV3RefusalParity_CLI in cmd/mcpproxy) each compare their own output to this file, so none of them can drift from another. `error` is the exact message; the CLI prints it as the first line of its error.

refusals.name: binding_bypassable_without_auth
refusals.error:
a client bound to profile

could escape it by omitting its credential while require_mcp_auth is off

refusals.name: no_client_credential
refusals.error: client <id> has no active client credential; connect it with a profile first
